'''Smooch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]]. She was seen in [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]], the City of Masks, in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. Like all the visitors and many inhabitants, she was in disguise, particularly with a mask of [[Caarite]] and a costume covered with the repeated word "[[Oink]]." The frisky Smooch was having a good time dancing and smooching anything not fast enough to escape.
